summary: Compositing and layers work focused on smoother scrolling and more reliable GPU resource handling: APZ (Asynchronous Pan/Zoom) now better tracks handed-off gestures, pinch locking, overscroll behavior, and scroll-data validity. Linux and Android now recycle DMA-BUF and Android hardware buffers for WebGL/WebGPU, while video pipelines preserve HDR metadata and correct luminance and color handling, including Wayland HDR and PQ video. The compositor also tightened IPC validation and capture permissions, hardened error paths, and updated timeline behavior to match the web standard.
